No new index, migration, timeout increase or relaxed recovery validation.
Repair scan counts explicitly represent reviewable saved occurrences; categories and same-code registered-ID evidence are included.

limits: Synthetic databases were used; no production database or authenticated game-client rollback was run.
Local in-memory timings are not production disk/server performance guarantees.
A suspect saved ID or familiar code name does not establish confirmed visible damage. Counts still require runtime/location verification.
Very large genuine affected-cell histories, slow disks, database contention and row caps can still stop recovery safely.
